zoe: Quick ask — we need a concise positioning matrix for sales + webinar on Apr 12. Focus: competitive narrative vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors. One-pager + talk tracks.

alexa: Who's the primary audience? AE field or inbound SDRs?

ben: AE + Solutions engineers. Want quick "when to pitch" bullets and rebuttals.

sam: Benchmarks to include: p50 latency, cost per 1k tokens, cold-start – and fallback story.

alexa: I'll turn talk tracks into 30s soundbites. Keep jargon light.

marketing-bot: Current refs: https://internal.redwood/positioning/old-matrix.pdf :page_facing_up: 

ben: Draft differentiators (short):
- Predictable unit economics via batching/caching
- Unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private
- Smart routing + graceful degradation fallbacks
- Enterprise controls (KMS, audit logs, VPC)

sam: Sample talk track for AEs:
```
Cloud vendor: "fast to launch"
AE: "Yes — but at scale we see TCO drift. Redwood gives same fast start + predictable per-token economics, and you can pin model versions or run private without re-architecting."
```

alexa: Love it. Also need 3 competitor rebuttals for infra vendors (price, control, ops). I'll draft.

zoe: Action items:
- alexa: 1-pager + 6 talk tracks by Tue (assigned)
- ben: gather top 5 customer objections from field by EOD Mon
- sam: pull latest latency/cost micro-benchmarks and fallback examples
- marketing-bot: create draft slide in /marketing/collab by Mon morning

alexa: ack. Will ping AEs for quotes.

ben: pinged SEs. got 2 quotes already.

zoe: Great — we'll iterate tomorrow in sprint slot. :thumbsup:
